konten_teks: This lesson covers Present Continuous. Students learn core concepts, practical usage, examples, vocabulary, and guided exercises. The material is designed for intermediate learners and can be expanded later with multimedia content and additional practice activities. Learners should complete the lesson and quiz before continuing to the next module.
